---
title: "OBIS widgets in Quarto"
format:
  html:
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        <script type="module" src="../dist/obis-hexmap.js"></script>
        <script type="module" src="../dist/obis-chart.js"></script>
---

Uses the demo cube at `internal/app/all_data.parquet` — generate it first
with `internal/prepare-parquet.R` if it isn't there yet (see the widgets
README), or point `parquet`/`manifest` at your own.

## Map

```{=html}
<obis-hexmap
  id="map"
  parquet="../../internal/app/all_data.parquet"
  manifest="../../internal/app/all_data.json"
  metric="n_records"
  height="420px">
</obis-hexmap>
```

## Chart (synced to the map above)

```{=html}
<obis-chart
  id="chart"
  kind="bar"
  parquet="../../internal/app/all_data.parquet"
  manifest="../../internal/app/all_data.json"
  metric="n_records"
  hide-controls>
</obis-chart>

<script type="module">
  document.getElementById('map').addEventListener('filterchange', (e) => {
    const chart = document.getElementById('chart');
    chart.filter = e.detail.filter;
    chart.metric = e.detail.metric;
  });
</script>
```
